name: settings.return_to_dial.selected_option
evidence: The row builder rejects indices above 2 and registers a callback for event code 7 with its row index as user data. The callback checks event code 7, calls the user-data getter, truncates its return to 8 bits, converts it to decimal and writes persist.back_dial_id. The getter veneer branches to SRAM code that returns the word at event + 12. The page root is set before building and cleared by the destroy callback.
scope: the user-data getter call in the return-to-dial option click callback while its page root is active
limitations: The 0, 1, 2 option values are inferred from the row builder bound. The underlying getter is shared globally; page root and caller filters do not prove quiescence of other callers during inline patch publication or rollback.
registration_evidence: Event registration uses object, callback, code 7 and row index as user data; its result is ignored by the caller.
